principles.title: The problem comes first.
principles.text: We start with a real need. Technology is the tool, not the starting point.

principles.title: Help should be easy to understand.
principles.text: We clearly explain what a service can do, what it costs and where its limits are.

principles.title: Your time belongs to you.
principles.text: We want to make tasks easier and enable real connections. Long screen time is not a measure of success.

principles.title: Trust is part of the experience.
principles.text: Privacy, fair pricing and clear expectations belong to a good user experience.

principles.title: Impact needs a foundation.
principles.text: Fair revenue should make support and fairly paid work possible. Benefit to people remains our measure of success.

steps.title: Listen
steps.text: We understand the initiative, the people behind it and the available resources.

steps.title: Connect
steps.text: We bring in suitable expertise and agree on goals and scope.

steps.title: Try
steps.text: We advise, develop early approaches and test what actually works.

steps.title: Improve
steps.text: We learn from feedback and improve the solution step by step.

participation.title: Share experiences
participation.text: Do you know a problem from everyday life? Your perspective helps us ask the right questions.

participation.title: Contribute expertise
participation.text: Advice, development, design or expertise in social work: contribute your strengths to our own projects.

participation.title: Try out ideas
participation.text: Help us understand and improve early approaches. You can already express an interest in testing.

participation.title: Explore a partnership
participation.text: As an organisation or specialist service, you can discuss how we might support people together.

participation.title: Support a project
participation.text: Financial or in-kind contributions could enable development and operations. The terms are still being clarified.

services.title: Rapid prototyping
services.summary: Make an idea tangible quickly and try it with limited effort.
services.description: An early prototype makes workflows and possibilities visible. Feedback helps test assumptions before a larger implementation begins.

services.title: AI consulting
services.summary: Identify where AI can make a useful contribution to your initiative.
services.description: We discuss suitable use cases, available data and organisational prerequisites. Together, we assess value, effort and limitations and outline a practical starting point.

services.title: Architecture review
services.summary: Examine technical structures and identify informed next steps.
services.description: We review the structure, interfaces and dependencies of a planned or existing solution. Maintainability, extensibility and security inform concrete, prioritised improvement proposals.

services.title: Concept review
services.summary: Challenge assumptions and refine a concept before implementation.
services.description: We examine goals, audiences, assumptions and planned workflows. This reveals open questions, inconsistencies and unnecessary complexity, providing a basis for a clear, implementable concept.

services.title: Advice & development
services.summary: Understand a need, connect the right people and implement a useful solution.
services.description: From initial guidance and technical advice to focused development, we shape the work around your organisation’s needs.

services.title: Feasibility assessments
services.summary: Find out early whether and how an initiative can be implemented usefully.
services.description: We examine technical options, dependencies and open questions to provide a basis for the next step.

services.title: Optimise existing solutions
services.summary: Improve what is already there instead of starting from scratch.
services.description: We examine workflows, usability and technical bottlenecks and propose targeted improvements to the existing solution.

services.title: Security testing
services.summary: Identify weaknesses and turn findings into practical improvements.
services.description: We examine the agreed areas of an existing solution, document risks and prioritise possible actions.

budgetSteps.title: Understand the need
budgetSteps.text: We listen and try to understand what your organisation wants to achieve and the idea behind it.

budgetSteps.title: Discuss the budget
budgetSteps.text: We talk openly about the available budget, including funding and voluntary contributions already factored in.

budgetSteps.title: Find the greatest value
budgetSteps.text: We look for the most useful solution within that budget. Together, we prioritise needs and agree on a suitable scope.

budgetSteps.title: Draw on our network
budgetSteps.text: If further support would help and has not already been included in the budget, we can approach our network for additional funding or voluntary contributions.
